prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Marta, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines for any bins left on the sidewalk past 8am. It’s finally happening, so make sure yours are moved immediately or you’ll be paying the price."
text: Did you hear that Mr. Henderson already got a warning sticker on his bin today? The council is cracking down with heavy fines for any bins left on the sidewalk past 8am, so please move yours immediately!
